+An HTTP server that parses the request line, headers, and Content-Length body before routing.
+Malformed or incomplete requests receive 400 Bad Request. Transfer-Encoding is not supported.
 
+Routes: GET `/`, GET `/users/:userId/posts/:postId`, and any method on `/echo`.
+`/echo` returns plain text containing the method and path (for example, `POST /echo`).
